description: Free on testnet (no payment, no wallet needed). Fuller answer for ONE Ledger row (protocol, platform, wallet or stablecoin): headline, status (authoritative), maturity (a plain-English stage derived from status, never contradicts it), steward, what_this_means (the detail after the headline, omitted if there is none), latest update date, verified date and up to 3 sources. Unknown names return result="unknown" with up to 3 did_you_mean names. Call list_protocols to see every name.

protocol.description: Ledger name or short name, e.g. 'x402', 'MPP', 'Stripe Link', 'Agent Pay'. Covers protocols, platforms, wallets and stablecoins. Call list_protocols for every name.

name: get_status_detail
